title: Bentness and distance to affine signs
statement: Let $n$ be even, and let $f$ be a sign-valued real function on the $n$-dimensional binary cube. Then $f$ is bent if and only if its minimum relative Hamming distance to an affine sign function is $\frac12-\frac12\,2^{-n/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is sign-valued on the $n$-dimensional binary cube
